args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Situation
- **checkout-api** was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history confirmed **v2.3.1** was the latest release and was **unhealthy**; the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

## Actions taken
1. **Opened SEV2 incident** — `INC-0001` ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the remediation. On-call was paged.
2. **Rollback attempt** — The `rollback` tool to v2.3.0 returned `503 Service Unavailable` on multiple retries, so I used the `deploy` tool to push the known-healthy **v2.3.0** to all production regions as the equivalent remediation.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now on **v2.3.0** in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to **0.002**.

## Current state
- Service: checkout-api — v2.3.0, healthy in all regions.
- Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up (root-cause analysis of v2.3.1 should be done before any redeploy).
